WITH customer_stats AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        max(DateKey) AS last_purchase_date,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS total_spend,
        count(DISTINCT ProductKey) AS distinct_products
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
max_date AS (
    SELECT max(DateKey) AS max_date FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
),
customer_segments AS (
    SELECT
        cs.CustomerKey,
        cs.total_spend,
        cs.distinct_products,
        dateDiff('day', cs.last_purchase_date, md.max_date) AS days_since_last_purchase,
        CASE
            WHEN dateDiff('day', cs.last_purchase_date, md.max_date) <= 90  THEN 'Active'
            WHEN dateDiff('day', cs.last_purchase_date, md.max_date) <= 180 THEN 'At Risk'
            ELSE 'Churned'
        END AS segment
    FROM customer_stats cs
    CROSS JOIN max_date md
)
SELECT
    segment,
    count(CustomerKey)            AS customer_count,
    round(avg(total_spend), 2)    AS avg_total_spend,
    round(avg(distinct_products), 2) AS avg_distinct_products
FROM customer_segments
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY
    multiIf(segment = 'Active', 1, segment = 'At Risk', 2, 3) ASC
